solarsheild-engine.description: SolarShield deterministic engine exposed as typed MCP tools. Tools: get_current_conditions, get_forecast, estimate_arrival, classify_severity, lookup_impact, cite_advisory. The server wraps the client-side deterministic core so Granite retrieves grounded values instead of hallucinating them.

tools.name: get_current_conditions
tools.description: Returns the latest normalized space-weather snapshot (Kp, solar wind speed, active alerts) from the cached NOAA/DONKI feeds. Every value includes its source and UTC timestamp.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Returns the latest CME and geomagnetic storm forecast from NASA DONKI, including estimated CME speed and expected impact time range.

tools.name: estimate_arrival
tools.description: Given a CME distance (km) and measured speed (km/s), calculates the deterministic arrival time with a ±6h uncertainty window. Returns null if speed is zero or missing — never invents a value.

tools.name: classify_severity
tools.description: Given a Kp index value, returns the NOAA G-scale classification (G1–G5) or null if the value is below threshold or missing. Thresholds are verbatim from NOAA.

tools.name: lookup_impact
tools.description: Given a G/S/R scale level string (e.g. 'G3'), returns the verbatim NOAA effect descriptions and action guidance with citation URL.

tools.name: cite_advisory
tools.description: Searches the parsed NOAA advisory corpus for passages relevant to a query. Returns matching chunks with section reference and citation URL.
